# Only the owning Plugin reports, and a confirmed outcome cannot change

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Submit work the fixture holds in progress

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<submission>",
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "input": {
    "label": "held",
    "hold": true
  }
}
```

→ **202** · Location `/plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>`
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "label": "held"
  },
  "output": null,
  "plugin_id": "fixture",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

## 2. An operator cannot report

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/reports` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "status": "completed"
}
```

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "This credential may not call this operation."
}
```

## 3. A failed outcome needs an error

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/reports` with <fixture plugin key>
```json
{
  "status": "failed"
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_report",
  "message": "A failed outcome needs an error, and only an outcome may carry one."
}
```

## 4. The Plugin confirms completion, and may repeat it

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/reports` with <fixture plugin key>
```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "output": {
    "label": "held",
    "stage": "reported"
  }
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "label": "held"
  },
  "output": {
    "label": "held",
    "stage": "reported"
  },
  "plugin_id": "fixture",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "completed",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/reports` with <fixture plugin key>
```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "output": {
    "label": "held",
    "stage": "reported"
  }
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "label": "held"
  },

  },
  "plugin_id": "fixture",

  "status": "completed",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

## 5. A different outcome afterwards conflicts

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/reports` with <fixture plugin key>
```json
{
  "status": "failed",
  "error": "late"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "terminal_operation",
  "message": "A confirmed outcome cannot change."
}
```
